## Overview
* **Parties:** Nimbus Cloud Pvt Ltd (Provider) and Zenith Retail Ltd (Customer) (Contract Data).
* **Term:** January 1, 2026, to December 31, 2026 (Contract Data).
* **Purpose:** This Agreement governs the provision of cloud services by Nimbus Cloud Pvt Ltd to Zenith Retail Ltd, establishing service uptime standards and payment obligations (Clause 3.1, Clause 5.1).

## Key dates
* **Effective Date:** January 1, 2026 (Contract Data).
* **Expiry Date:** December 31, 2026 (Contract Data).
* **Notice Deadline:** October 2, 2026 is the last day to give a 90-day written notice of non-renewal to prevent automatic renewal (Clause 4.2 / Upcoming Events).

## Money
* **Payment Terms:** Customer must pay all invoices within 15 days of the invoice date (Clause 5.1). The first invoice is payable by February 1, 2026 (Clause 5.2).
* **Late Fees:** Late payments incur a 10% late fee (Clause 5.1).

## Top risks
* **High Severity:** The agreement contains a highly restrictive limitation of liability capped at only 3 months of fees paid (Clause 11).
* **Medium Severity:** The contract automatically renews for successive 12-month terms unless a party provides a written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the current term (Clause 4.2).
* **Medium Severity:** Late payments are subject to a high penalty fee of 10% (Clause 5.1).

## Action items
* **Pay First Invoice:** Zenith Retail Ltd must pay the first invoice by February 1, 2026 (Clause 5.2).
* **Maintain Uptime:** Nimbus Cloud Pvt Ltd must maintain a 99.0% uptime service level each calendar month (Clause 3.1).
* **Provide Non-Renewal Notice:** Either party wishing to prevent automatic renewal must submit a written notice of non-renewal by October 2, 2026 (Clause 4.2 / Upcoming Events).
* **Protect Confidentiality:** Each party must keep the other's confidential information secret for 3 years following the termination of the agreement (Clause 9.1).

This summary assists human review and is not legal advice.
